# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.1.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities to security@frontal.dev. Do not disclose security issues publicly.

We will acknowledge your report within 48 hours and provide an initial assessment within 7 days.

## Scope

This policy covers the `@frontal/upgrade-risk` npm package and its GitHub Action.
